contextNote.title: A protective image
contextNote.text: The tiny monk beneath Tara’s right hand commissioned this painting. In the Cleveland Museum’s account, her green colour and gesture connect her with protection from fear. A mantra on the back also expresses that protective purpose: the image was made for devotional use.

claims.text: The small monastic figure beneath Tara’s right hand commissioned the painting.
The museum links Tara’s colour, gesture and the mantra on the reverse with protection from fear.

contextNote.interpretationLimit: This describes a particular Tibetan Buddhist devotional context. It does not assume the viewer shares its beliefs or experiences the promised protection.
